label.description: Edition label derived from the period ("October 2026").

summary_meta.description: How the summary was made: `weeks` (the weekly recaps used, `week_start`/`week_end`), `covered_start`/`covered_end` (first and last day of those weeks, which may stick out of the month; null without recaps), `uncovered` (ranges of the window that no used week covers, e.g. the last days of a month whose final week is not finished yet), `model`, `token_usage` (`skipped` with a `reason` when no call was made: `no_recaps` or `llm_error`), `dropped` (items removed or replaced by the grounding check), `parse_failed` and `error` (null normally; the exception class name, plus ` (HTTP <code>)` when it carries one, e.g. `RateLimitError (HTTP 429)`, when the model call failed: never the exception message. The ranked items are still there and the summary is empty until the next scheduled retry or a rebuild).

summary_text.description: Suggested Executive Summary: one Indonesian paragraph condensed from the weekly recaps that overlap the window. get.description:
Topik naik untuk newsroom. Tren selalu "N hari berakhir hari ini vs N hari sebelumnya"
(`get_trending`), jadi tanggal filter diubah jadi jendela `days` yang berjangkar ke hari
ini: `days = (hari ini - posted_on_start).days + 1`, di-clamp ke [1, 3650] (batas yang
sama dengan `days` di `/api/dashboard/*`): tanpa clamp, `posted_on_start=0001-01-01`
meledak jadi 500 (tanggal sebelum tahun 1) dan tahun 1900 mengalokasikan ratusan ribu
bucket harian. Tanggal di masa depan -> 1. `posted_on_end` diterima tapi diabaikan.
Tanpa `posted_on_start` dipakai aturan "semua waktu" `get_trending`
(`days=None` -> 7 hari vs 7 hari).

422.description: Invalid field, or the probe failed and nothing was saved. `detail` is a string, or an object `{message, probe: {status, detail}}` for a failed probe

429.description: Rate limit, test cooldown, or too many failed password attempts

503.description: SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEYS is not configured on the server

terverifikasi katalog); `vendor_id` / `family_id` = tombol Monitor di All Tech (entri katalog

riwayatnya dari mirror (bila promosi dinyalakan).

tidak dihapus.
